purpose: Teach: 目黒/野中/渡部/三宅/酒井/武部/高野/久保田

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目黒署と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: The police are conducting a joint investigation with the Meguro precinct, I see.
lines.style: Measured, respectful acknowledgment. Slight nod of recognition in the vocal tone. Professional but warm—noticing competence without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、野中刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: Detective Nonaka's response at the scene was handled well too.
lines.style: Quiet commendation. Steady pace, even weight on each phrase. The tone of someone who knows police work and respects it when it's done right.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人渡部氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: They're taking careful statements from the witness, Watanabe.
lines.style: Calm, observational. Slight pause before the name—acknowledging the care being taken with each person. Measured, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者三宅氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: They're organizing the testimony from eyewitness Miyake.
lines.style: Administrative detail delivered with quiet efficiency. Matter-of-fact but not cold. The voice of someone tracking the steps of a process.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者酒井の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.style: Brief, factual. A small pause before the name—neutral but not detached. Straightforward, no extra weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者武部氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: They're showing consideration for the victim's family, Takebe.
lines.style: Soft shift here—still professional but with a thread of human care running through it. Slower on the name. The acknowledgment that this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士高野様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: They're consulting with the psychologist, Takano.
lines.style: Respectful of specialized expertise. Slight lift on the name—recognition of someone brought in for their knowledge. Warm but professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、鑑識の久保田主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: Kubota, the forensics lead, will be doing the scene verification with them.
lines.style: Closer, more personal. The name comes first, grounded. Still professional but with a thread of personal respect—you know this person's work.
